acceptanceCriteria: The Go plugin skips directories named `testdata` (and their descendants) when building units, matching the go tool's rule.
A changed file under a `testdata/` directory no longer produces a `NO_SELECTABLE_TEST` unknown; the owning non-testdata package is still traced as before.
`corvint affected --base 062b0151` reports the same selected set as before the change.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the V1-0187 review (NIT 3). The Go plugin of `internal/liveverify/affected` records `testdata/` directories as Go units although the go tool ignores them. With AFP-V0-020 a changed `testdata/` directory can be reported as a changed untested Go package in `plan.unknown`, so the plan turns UNKNOWN for a fixture-only edit.
title: affected: Go plugin indexes `testdata/` directories, which surface as NO_SELECTABLE_TEST noise
